description: Misty Mountains with Biplanes watercolour mural 1484x1060 (about 4:3): three vintage biplanes and three striped hot-air balloons (blue-grey and cream stripes, bunting on the big one) fly over snow-capped misty mountains, a few birds, pine forest in the lower third. Palette: dusty blue-grey, milk beige, soft peach glow in the clouds, sage and grey-green trees. Calm, airy, vintage aviation; no pink, no bright colours: a room for a boy. The planes and balloons sit in the upper two thirds of the wall, mountains and forest in the lower third, so a child standing in the room covers only mountains and trees.
